items.title: John Bunch interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: You know I was influenced by people like Johnny Hodges.

ctx.x: Is there a specific art to playing a ballad? What goes into playing a great ballad on the keyboard?

I don’t know. Well I think you have to listen to records a lot. You know I was influenced by people like Johnny Hodges. I immediately think when you mention that I think of Johnny Hodges of Duke Ellington’s band you know. And people like that. Yank Lawson, the trumpet player who just passed away a year ago. Certain musicians that I really think were — really had — almost made you cry when they play a ballad you know. Oh, the violinist, Ray Nance with Duke Ellington. I was crazy about Duke Ellington as you can…
Seeing a great artist in person is different from just getting the record, isn’t it?
